meta.title: High-Frequency Order Throughput Tests
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create stress tests that submit orders at high frequency to validate order processing throughput and rate limit handling.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: High-frequency test passes: 10 orders/second for 60 seconds, all tracked, no lost/duplicated
Latency meets NFR1: less than 100ms, with p50/p95/p99 percentiles measured
Rate limit warning at 80% capacity, throttling without rejections
Rate limit exceeded (429) handled with backoff, retry, no crash
Burst patterns tested: 10 orders in 1 second handled without failure

key-tasks.task: Implement sustained throughput test (10 orders/sec for 60 sec)

architecture-context.pattern: Token bucket algorithm at adapter level Limits: 600 requests/minute REST, 20 orders/second per symbol

technical-specifications.spec:
async def test_sustained_order_throughput(): target_rate = 10 # orders per second duration = 60 # seconds total_orders = target_rate * duration
for i in range(total_orders): order_id = await broker.submit_order(...) latencies.append(time.monotonic() - order_start) order_ids.append(order_id) # Rate limit to target
assert len(order_ids) == total_orders assert len(set(order_ids)) == total_orders # No duplicates assert max(latencies) < 0.100 # 100ms
